subject: Mutual action plan: isolated GPU reservation, scaling & SLA clarifications
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Ashwin Rao <ashwin@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: isolated GPU reservation, scaling & SLA clarifications

Hi Ashwin —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and the mutual action items we discussed so teams can align:

Summary of what we heard from you:
- Primary workload: real-time multimodal inference for clinical triage, peak bursts at month-end.
- Current pain: unpredictable token-level latency and noisy tail latency during concurrent jobs.
- Compliance note: PHI scope limited to inference outputs; customer wants VPC + audit logs.
- Desired outcome: predictable 99th percentile latency <= 120ms for 1k rps baseline, ability to scale to 5k rps for monthly bursts.

What Redwood proposes (high level):
1) Dedicated, isolated GPU pool (reserved) with siloed tenancy and optional burst nodes.
2) Autoscaling buckets: baseline capacity for 1k rps, fast-burst to 5k rps (pre-warmed kernels + KV-cache sharing disabled across tenants).
3) SLA target conversation: 99p latency SLO vs best-effort during burst window; proposed contractual 99p <= 150ms with operational playbook to hit 120ms in typical conditions.
4) Compliance: Private control plane option (VPC peering) + KMS integration for keys; detailed audit log packet to be provided.

Mutual action plan (MAP) we agreed to capture:
- Neurolytics: share representative traffic profile (token lengths, concurrency curve, peak minutes per month) — Ashwin/Priya to send by Wed 5/5.
- Redwood: provide preliminary SLO write-up + ops playbook for isolation & burst behavior — Karthik/Monica to send by Fri 5/7.
- Neurolytics: confirm procurement timeline and any legal security questionnaire priority items — Ashwin to loop in procurement.
- Redwood: provide cost anchor (baseline vs burst) and optional canary rollout plan for first 3 months.

Immediate asks from our side: please share a 24–72 hour p99 trace sample or the aggregated tail-latency histogram (CSV or JSON) and the monthly burst calendar (which days you expect >3x baseline). That will let us size reserve vs burst policy.

Attachments: I attached a short SLO/ops checklist and a draft MOP we can iterate on.

Next steps: if you can confirm timelines above, I’ll convert this MAP into a shared Google Sheet and propose a kickoff for Wed 5/12 (30–45m) to align infra and security owners.

Thanks —
Karthik
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

[attachment: slo-proposal-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — preliminary SLO targets and cost anchors]
[attachment: neurolytics-mop-draft.pdf (pdf) — ops/playbook stub]

From: Ashwin Rao <ashwin@neurolytics.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Banerjee <priya@neurolytics.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: isolated GPU reservation, scaling & SLA clarifications

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap. Short answers and a couple clarifications from our side:

1) Traffic profile — we can send a 72-hour p99 histogram and raw request-rate CSV by EOD Wed 5/5. That should show the monthly spike pattern (we get predictable month-end surges).
2) PHI scope — correct, only inference outputs; we will need SOC2 artifacts and an explanation of how audit trails are retained for 7 years (regulator ask).
3) Capacity ask — 1k baseline, burst to 5k is accurate. Important: bursts are typically sustained for 30–90 minutes.
4) SLA framing — we like the approach of a contractual 99p <= 150ms with an operational target of 120ms; want to see the ops playbook around fallback behavior (model variant fallback vs throttling).

Procurement note: procurement kickoff likely mid-May; legal will want a sample MSA with the proposed SLO language.

We’ll attach the CSVs to the MAP sheet once you create it. Also: Priya flagged that we'll want a runbook snippet on incident notifications (pager vs email) and escalation SLAs.

Appreciate it — speak soon.

—Ashwin
Head of Engineering, Neurolytics
ashwin@neurolytics.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Ashwin Rao <ashwin@neurolytics.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 07:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: isolated GPU reservation, scaling & SLA clarifications

Adding a couple of ops-level clarifications before I draft the playbook:

- Isolation model: we propose single-tenant CUDA allocation for Neurolytics with network-level ACLs; burst nodes will sit in a separate autoscale pool with scheduled pre-warm windows (customer-configurable).
- Cache behavior: by default we’ll disable cross-tenant KV cache sharing to avoid warmup contamination; we can enable per-customer prefix caching to reduce baseline cost.
- Canary plan: two-week canary with traffic shadowing + slow ramp to 25/50/100% of baseline.

I’ll draft the SLO appendix with incident notification windows (P1 pager within 15 mins, P2 email within 2 hours) and a proposed credit policy tied to 99p bands. Sending draft by Fri 5/7.

Monica
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

[internal note: Rishi — can you pull the GPU kernel warmup times from perf lab for A100/4x-A10 profiles? Need for cost anchor table]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Thanks Ashwin, Priya — and thanks Monica for the notes.

I created the shared MAP and uploaded the two attachments (copy link below). Outline for the kickoff: 30m — infra + security + procurement owners; agenda: traffic handoff, SLO framing, procurement timeline, next 90-day canary plan. Can you confirm:

- Date preference for kickoff: Wed 5/12 10:00am PT (we have infra folks available), or Thu 5/13 11:00am PT.
- Who from Neurolytics should be at the kickoff (security and procurement names ideally)?

Links and attachments:
- MAP sheet: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C4D
- SLO & MOP drafts: https://drive.google.com/open?id=5F6G7H8I

I’ll also attach the perf-anchor spreadsheet Monica requested once Rishi drops the lab numbers.

If those times don’t work, propose alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Best —
Karthik
